ledger.title: Tested settled sequences conserve value; a debt open temporarily removes its margin from the listed claims
ledger.angle: A1 value conservation under sequences; A2 size and boundary extremes; A3 self-impact; A4 queue interaction
ledger.precondition: exact pinned and set-2 runtimes on a saved transaction read-set, with mocked HyperCore responses and a coherently seeded queue
ledger.trigger: same-quote cycles, wins, losses, liquidations, harvests, boundaries, withdrawals, batches and one debt-funded lifecycle
ledger.impact: The book identity holds on 103 of 107 steps. The only non-control deviation is a positive 1000 USDC residual while debt margin is open; the same-quote close restores the queued claim and zero residual. No negative residual or extra payout appears in the coherent lifecycle.
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay against both exact runtimes with queue pointers seeded from pinned state
ledger.missing_observation: The replay uses a saved transaction read-set and mocked HyperCore replies; it is not a full-state live fork or an exhaustive proof of every queue state.

ledger.title: The claimed repeatable debt-cycle mint came from omitted queue pointers in the replay fixture
ledger.precondition: the saved transaction read-set omitted queue head and next-id slots 16 and 17; the corrected run seeds their pinned values
ledger.trigger: compare the previously reported cycle with the coherent queue lifecycle
ledger.impact: The coherent replay consumes 1000 USDC of queued credit on debt open, restores the claim on a zero-PnL close, pays the existing queue once, and rejects a second debt open. The earlier 3237.31 USDC gain and 20000 USDC excess are artifacts of the incomplete fixture and are withdrawn.
ledger.evidence_tier: corrected exact-runtime replay against both pinned and set-2 implementations
ledger.missing_observation: No full-state live fork was run; this disproof applies to the specific previously claimed repeatable cycle.

ledger.title: The Exchange side bucket is an earmark of the spendable LP bankroll, not a claim, so the repo's conservation identity double counts it whenever it is nonzero
ledger.precondition: the real chain state at block 48,173,889, saved in artifacts/historical/accounting_states.json, plus the live replay of the queue-live branches
ledger.trigger: compare treasury - reserved with trackedLp + totalQueued and with trackedLp + totalQueued + side
ledger.impact: at block 48,173,889 the close wrote 400296219202209635129 into Exchange slot 27, and the archive reads queue harvest availability = 400296219202209635129 = trackedLp 377424392655154164362 + totalQueued 22871826547055470767, while trackedLp + totalQueued + side would be 800592438404419270258. The side bucket is the bankroll the queue harvest is allowed to draw on, so it is already counted in trackedLp + totalQueued and must not be added again. In the live replay the same relation holds at both side-bucket writes (side == trackedLp + totalQueued after the queue-live liquidation and after the loss with a live queue). The repo's atlas_all_suite_claims.py identity adds the side bucket; it reconciles only because the pinned side bucket is zero
ledger.evidence_tier: saved archive getter reads at a real block plus exact-runtime replay
ledger.missing_observation: no archive capture of every book field at 48,173,889 (only the availability getters, tracked LP and the queue total); the correction rests on those getters, which are defined as treasury less the reserved claims

ledger.title: Every other sequence is neutral: five same-quote cycles, a win, a loss, a liquidation, harvests, both sides of one market, dust and boundary sizes, close then withdraw, and a two-close BatchExecutor batch all reconcile exactly, and each blocked path names its guard
ledger.angle: A1 sequences; A2 extremes; A3 self-impact; A4 queue interaction; A5 double payment
ledger.precondition: the live set-2 runtimes on the saved prestate
ledger.trigger: the twelve sequences of the harness; each guard row below quotes the raw revert selector returned
ledger.impact: the user's claim returns to exactly its starting value after five same-quote open/close cycles (1000000000000000000000000 == the 1000000e18 credit); a same-quote close settles adj = 0 with no fee and no mint; a deferred win is paid exactly once at harvest with tracked LP already debited at the close (the harvest is a pure queue-to-balance reclassification, tracked LP delta zero) and a second harvest reverts QueueEmpty() (0x75e52f4f); a liquidation on an empty queue reverts the same; a one-wei margin opens and closes with a one-unit balance delta and no rounding leak; the deadband boundary settles at exactly zero; both sides of one market closed in one batch at the same quote settle at zero; two closes through the real BatchExecutor allowlist both execute with the residual at zero; the withdrawal with a true account status debits exactly the signed amount; and the guards are: OiCapExceeded() 0x40f92143 when the per-side aggregate would pass the configured limit, LeverageTooHigh() 0x0a4f5a07 above leverage 1000, QueueEmpty() 0x75e52f4f on an empty harvest, the one-withdrawal-per-user-per-block gate, and the no-queued-credit debt open 0x8e667356
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay, exact live and pinned runtimes
ledger.missing_observation: the notional unit behind the OI cap stays unresolved: the aggregate the open compares with is a 96-bit market word and the limit a 128-bit word, so the boundary is quoted as the measured raw aggregate (the s8 opens), not as a USDC notional

ledger.title: pushStakerFees (the LP-surplus distribution) is unreachable from a stranger, the keeper and the owner in this replay: raw 0x538ccdfd on set 2 and 0x64cd1788 pinned, while an unknown selector reverts with empty data
ledger.angle: A5 extracting the LP's excess share early
ledger.precondition: the LP cursor forced above the 5,000,000 USDC cap with a totalQueued of zero, and a second state with a negative LP cursor and a live queue
ledger.trigger: pushStakerFees() 0x7b9f5264 from a stranger, the keeper and the owner, plus a control call to an unknown selector in the same state
ledger.impact: every caller gets a custom error (0x538ccdfd on set 2, 0x64cd1788 pinned) with no storage write and no log, so the LP-excess and staker-fee distribution cannot be exercised from this prestate; the control shows the selector exists (an unknown selector reverts with empty data), so the failure is a state check rather than a missing entry point. The LP-surplus path therefore stays unproven here, and the pass-one read-only pin probe that allowed an unrelated caller is not reproduced
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay, exact live and pinned runtimes
ledger.missing_observation: the saved prestate is a transaction read-set, so the pointer or flag pushStakerFees checks is absent; the name of 0x538ccdfd and 0x64cd1788 is unresolved
